title: 5 Classic ’90s English Dub Anime That Surpass the Originals
content: The debate over which is better — subbed or dubbed anime — has persisted for years, but these English dubs streaming on Crunchyroll are some of the best in the game. Many anime fans are steadfast in the belief that all series should be viewed in their original Japanese forms.

title: Fan-Favorite Anime Confirms Season 4 Return After 3 Years With First Trailer – Watch
content: Laid-Back Camp , one of the most beloved slice-of-life anime of all time , is returning with a Season 4 next year. With the anime industry oversaturated with Shonen and action series, Laid-Back Camp is a breath of fresh air with its cozy and heartwarming vibe.

title: Dragon Ball Super Needs to Figure Out What’s Next for Broly
content: The reintroduction to Broly brought up a lot of possibilities when it comes to his future in the Dragon Ball universe, but all of that is still unknown.
